indicators.label: Census population total
indicators.description: Unit whole-population count represented in the wave's religion table.
indicators.method: Printed unit total: 2004 Vol I Table 5.2; 2014 table 2.1; 2024 ethnocultural annex table 5.29.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Moldova right-bank raions and municipalities (35 units)
indicators.quality_notes: Whole enumerated resident population, all ages, in every wave. Right bank only: Transnistria and Bender are not enumerated (rendered as no-data); Căuşeni and Dubăsari are enumerated in their central-government-controlled parts only (flagged). National totals fall across the series (3,383,332; 2,804,801; 2,409,207) with population change, not a religion change.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the unit population reporting affiliation with a declared religion.
indicators.method: 2004: (total - Atei - Fără religie - Nedeclarată)/total. 2014: (12 named confessions)/total. 2024: (10 named categories Ortodoxă ... Alte religii)/total.
indicators.quality_notes: Category frames differ across waves (2004: 15 columns; 2014: 14 declared + not-declared; 2024: 14 declared + not-declared), so no cross-wave category change is claimed; the comparable spine is the Orthodox share and the aggregate declared-affiliation share, carried verbatim per unit. Percentages use each unit's printed census total. In every wave the not-declared line (2004 Nedeclarată; 2014/2024 the separate not-declared column) stays in the denominator and outside both numerators, so the two shares need not sum to 100%. No-religion is each wave's own atheist/no-religion block, which differs across waves (2004 Atei + Fără religie; 2014 Agnostic + Ateu; 2024 Liber cugetător + Agnostic + Ateu + Fără religie); a fine-category cross-wave change is withheld.

indicators.label: No religion %
indicators.description: Share of the unit population in the wave's atheist/no-religion block.
indicators.method: 2004: (Atei + Fără religie)/total. 2014: (Agnostic + Ateu)/total. 2024: (Liber cugetător + Agnostic + Ateu + Fără religie)/total.
indicators.quality_notes: The no-religion block is not cell-comparable across waves (2014 carries no separate 'fără religie' line at raion grain); each wave renders its own block. Not-declared is a disclosed denominator residual, never folded into this slot.

visual_layers.label: Religious affiliation %
visual_layers.notes: Census affiliation, not practice or membership. Transnistria and Bender render as no-data (not enumerated). Căuşeni and Dubăsari are enumerated in their controlled parts only (flagged).

visual_layers.label: No religion %
visual_layers.description: Moldova census atheist/no-religion share by raion/municipality.
visual_layers.notes: Each wave's own atheist/no-religion block; not cell-comparable across waves. Not-declared is excluded from this slot.
